name: Clinical Consultation Note - Eleanor Vance
expected_transcription:
Patient Consultation Note
Date: 14 Oct 2024
Patient: Eleanor Vance (ID: EV-88219)

Chief Complaint: Persistent cough and mild dyspnea for 3 weeks.
History: No history of smoking. Prior allergy to penicillin noted in 2018.
Examination: BP 124/82 mmHg, HR 76 bpm, SpO2 97% on room air.
Chest clear to auscultation bilaterally. No audible wheezes or crackles.

Assessment & Plan:
1. Upper respiratory tract post-viral hyperreactivity.
2. Prescribe Albuterol inhaler 90 mcg 2 puffs PRN.
3. Do NOT initiate oral corticosteroids at this time.
4. Follow-up in clinic in 14 days if symptoms persist.
